authoritativeText.text:
[Upper prose block 1; p; refs p0161#11]
在§56中，教材曾介绍在大气压强作用下，玻璃管中的水随活塞而升高的实验。
**活塞式抽水机**就是利用这种现象工作的。

[Upper prose block 2; p; refs p0162#1]
图160a所示的活塞式抽水机由一个圆筒构成。
圆筒中有一个和筒壁接触紧密、可以上下移动的活塞1，在圆筒的底部和活塞上各装有一个只能向上开的阀门2。
当活塞向上移动时，水在大气压强的作用下顶起下边的阀门进入管中，随着活塞一起上升。

[Upper prose block 3; p; refs p0162#2]
当活塞向下移动时，活塞下面的水把下边的阀门压住，使它关闭。
但在水压的作用下，活塞上的阀门却打开了，水就进到活塞的上方。
当活塞再次上移时，这部分水就随活塞一起升高而流进出水管中。

与此同时，在活塞下面又重新进入一部分水，而这部分水在活塞再次下移时就又升入活塞上面，就这样不断地把水抽上来。

[Upper prose block 4; fig; refs p0162#3]
Figure fig-160; printed label 图 160

[Upper prose block 5; cap; refs p0162#4]
图160a 图160b
装有空气室的活塞式抽水机：1—活塞；2—抽水阀门；3—压水阀门；4—空气室；5—手柄。

[问题; refs p0162#6]
（1）活塞式抽水机是利用什么现象工作的？

[问题; refs p0162#7]
（2）这种抽水机的构造如何？是怎样工作的？

[问题; refs p0163#1]
（3）这种抽水机抽水的最大高度是多少？

[练习29; refs p0163#3]
（1）在理论讨论中，若用活塞式抽水机（参看图160a）抽水银，那么能抽到的最大高度是多少？为什么？
本题不要求实际操作水银。

[练习29; refs p0163#4]
（2）若抽的是酒精，能抽到的最大高度又是多少？

[练习29; refs p0163#5]
（3）试说明装有空气室的活塞式抽水机（图160b）的工作过程。
其中的空气室起什么作用？
用这种抽水机能把深于10.3米的水抽上来吗？

inventory.description: a has its own open reservoir, submerged uncapped intake and explicit water surface.
a cylinder has a rod opening at its rim and distinct side outlet and bottom intake ports.
a piston 1 fits the cylinder, has the separately seated piston valve 2 and the bridge/rod connection.
a separate bottom valve 2 is lifted, with two source upward-flow arrows.
a complete lever, pivot, support return and source upward rod-motion arrow.
a side outlet retains both walls, an open downturned mouth and a falling stream.
b has its own open reservoir, submerged uncapped intake and water surface.
b cylinder retains separate rod-rim, suction and right-hand delivery ports.
b solid piston 1 has no piston valve, with its rod and original downstroke arrow.
b bottom suction valve 2 is closed in the shown downstroke.
b complete hand lever 5, pivot and support attachment.
b separate bent delivery passage joins cylinder to open upward delivery valve 3 at chamber bottom.
b sealed rounded air chamber 4 preserves upper air, lower water and their interface around the riser.
b riser begins underwater, passes through chamber dome, bends down to an open outlet, and has the source upward flow arrow.
Two source subfigures, normalized Latin a and b, with no invented measurements.
